questions.question: Who directed Star Wars: The Force Awakens, which brought Harrison Ford back as Han Solo?
questions.note: Abrams directed the 2015 sequel, Ford’s first Han Solo appearance since 1983.

questions.question: In The Force Awakens, what is the real name of Kylo Ren, Han Solo’s son?
questions.note: Kylo Ren is the name Ben takes after turning to the dark side.

questions.question: Who directed Blade Runner 2049, which reunited Ford with Rick Deckard?
questions.note: Villeneuve directed the 2017 sequel; Scott returned as a producer.

questions.question: In Blade Runner 2049, where has Deckard been hiding for decades?
questions.note: Deckard lives alone amid the radioactive ruins of Las Vegas.

questions.question: In The Call of the Wild, what is Harrison Ford’s wilderness character named?
questions.note: Ford plays Thornton in the 2020 adaptation of Jack London’s novel.

questions.question: The Call of the Wild is adapted from a novel by which writer?
questions.note: London’s 1903 novel follows the dog Buck during the Klondike Gold Rush.

questions.question: In Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny, what is Indy’s goddaughter named?
questions.note: Phoebe Waller-Bridge plays Helena, daughter of Indy’s old friend Basil Shaw.

questions.question: In Captain America: Brave New World, what office does Thaddeus Ross hold?
questions.note: Ford took over the role of Thaddeus “Thunderbolt” Ross in the 2025 film.

questions.question: In Captain America: Brave New World, into which Marvel character does Thaddeus Ross transform?
questions.note: Ross becomes Red Hulk during the movie’s climactic confrontation.

questions.question: In Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker, Ford appears briefly again as which character?
questions.note: Ford returns in a vision-like scene with Ben Solo; it is not a new Han Solo adventure.
